title: Adapt document snapshots and product export completeness to shared controlled datasets
description: Reuse existing product field completeness rules and trade document persisted header/line snapshot semantics through two controlled datasets and presets. Document print and ledger exports are separate registry entries; preserve grain and truthful unsupported document-layout features. Do not regenerate trade documents, rewrite snapshots or introduce new calculations. Stage 2 only; no dedicated business-report controller/designer/exporter, arbitrary SQL, schema/migrations/production operations, secrets/env edits, permission expansion or unrelated changes. Preserve old entries until every migration has genuine parity acceptance. Tests may write only guarded (localdb)\NEWERP_AutoAcceptance / NEWERP_AUTOTEST_* databases.
acceptance_criteria: Expose finite product-export-field-completeness and trade-document controlled catalogs and presets for export:product-export-field-completeness, document:trade-document-print and document:trade-document-export-excel. Reuse ProductExportFieldCompletenessRules.BuildRow/group rules and TradeDocumentPrintModel.From with persisted snapshots; retain original endpoints and distinguish header/line grain.

On every catalog/preview/export recheck product or doc-center menu and current-user data scope. Reject unresolved or unsupported restricted scope before reading global source data. Bound document/product selections, line/page counts and dates; preserve null legacy snapshots, original currency/unit and prevent header amounts repeated across detail aggregation. No unrestricted joins or reconstructed missing evidence; bounded errors and audit remain active.

Compare generic preview/Excel/PDF semantic fields to existing completeness and document print/export fixtures, including truncation, missing snapshots, denied/revoked menus, safe grouping, multiple currency/unit and header cardinality. Run isolated SQL fixtures, related tests, safe Release build/unit suite and scheduler self-test/contracts. Layout/legacy export compatibility not yet reproduced must stay unsupported/unverified and must not mark migration parity-passed.
implementation_evidence: Verified existing ProductExportFieldCompleteness.cs controller bounded query and Application ProductExportFieldCompletenessRules; TradeDocumentController.GetPrint/ExportExcel and Application.Interfaces.TradeDocumentPrintDtos.cs provide persisted snapshot model. Registry includes three keys but no corresponding providers/presets. Existing tasks 297-304 cover different families; no document/product migration task exists.
